**Pick Rossi Idraulica.** 3,950 EUR all in, 10 year warranty, two weeks out. Report saved to `vault/Projects/Research/2026-10-08-0014-boiler-replacement-quote-comparison.md` and attached.

| | Rossi Idraulica | TermoCasa |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR (3,400 + 22%) |
| Warranty | 10 yr, needs yearly service | 5 yr |
| Timing | Two weeks | Next week |

The maths checks (3,400 x 1.22 = 4,148), so Rossi is 198 EUR cheaper on the total despite the lower-looking headline at TermoCasa. On top of that you get double the warranty, the same Vaillant brand as your 2019 unit, and Marta already knows your system and does the annual service the warranty depends on.

TermoCasa wins only on speed, one week against two. Worth taking only if the current boiler dies outright, the expansion vessel fix turns into a bigger problem, or a cold snap lands in the gap.

One correction to flag: the report says the warranty period difference matters most if you actually keep up the yearly service, so get in writing what the 10 years covers (heat exchanger only, or parts and labour) and what one missed service year does to it.

[qwen-local-direct · write · $0.0000]
